title: Fantasy Foosball Weekly: Year 8, 2026 Week 10 Preview
subtitle: With six playoff spots available, the model highlights sharply different levels of urgency across this slate.

playoffModel.description: Seeded Monte Carlo estimate using current record, scoring strength and remaining Sleeper schedule.

matchups.headline: Joey Faces a Major Playoff Swing Against Payton
matchups.paragraph: Payton’s I ♥️ Big Tet-Tees enters Week 10 ranked third at 6-3, with a 97.9% modeled playoff chance. The two-time champion’s outlook rises to 99.7% with a win and falls to 94% with a loss, a relatively modest 5.7-point swing. Joey’s Off Constantly, ranked fifth at 5-4, faces much greater volatility: its 47% chance climbs to 67.7% after a win but drops to 37.7% after a loss. For Joey, this matchup carries the clearest immediate playoff leverage.

matchups.headline: CJ Needs an Upset to Keep the Model Within Reach
matchups.paragraph: Andy’s Long dong silvers hold second place at 7-2 and an 86.3% modeled playoff chance. A win would push that figure to 98.5%, while a loss would lower it to 76.1%, making this meaningful even for a strong contender. CJ’s cjbroadway23 is eighth at 4-5, with a 27.5% chance to reach the six-team playoff. The model gives CJ a 40.5% chance with a win and only 12.1% with a loss, a 28.4-point swing and a major opportunity to improve the outlook.

matchups.headline: Kane Holds the Edge While Kohlt Needs a Breakthrough
matchups.paragraph: Kane’s Blueballs sits sixth at 5-4, occupying the final playoff position with a 74.3% modeled playoff chance. A win raises that estimate to 82.6%, while a loss drops it to 56.4%, an important 26.2-point swing. Kohlt’s kohlt is ranked 10th at 3-6 and has only a 0.9% chance in the current model. Even victory would move that estimate to just 2.6%, while a loss lowers it to 0.1%. The model therefore gives Kane clear leverage and Kohlt a very narrow path.

matchups.headline: Kade and Parker Meet in a High-Volatility Playoff Test
matchups.paragraph: Kade’s CheesusJesus is ninth at 4-5, with an 11.3% modeled playoff chance entering Week 10. A win would lift that figure to 27.2%, but a loss would reduce it to 3.3%, making the 23.9-point swing significant. Parker’s My BallDak hurts, ranked seventh at 4-5, starts with a stronger 55.2% chance. The model gives Parker a 67.4% chance with a win and 30.8% with a loss, a 36.6-point swing. Parker, the 2019 inaugural champion, has the better position, but both outlooks are highly sensitive.

matchups.headline: Evan’s Perfect Model Outlook Meets Brae’s Winless Record
matchups.paragraph: Evan’s Bonnie Blue 42 leads the league at 8-1 and has a 100% modeled playoff chance, matching the top rank and the certainty of a guaranteed-looking position without treating the estimate as a guarantee. The model remains at 100% whether Evan wins or loses, so the supplied playoff odds show no swing. Brae’s Ogles Outlaws is 0-9 and ranked 12th, with a 0% modeled chance. That figure stays at 0% under either result, making this the slate’s clearest example of unchanged playoff odds.

matchups.headline: Alex Protects a Near-Certain Chance Against Cooper
matchups.paragraph: Alex’s I love big TD’s enters ranked fourth at 6-3, carrying a 99.7% modeled playoff chance after winning the 2025 championship. A win nudges the estimate to 99.9%, while a loss brings it to 97.8%, just a 2.1-point swing. Cooper’s Jack MeHoff is 11th at 2-7, with a 0% modeled playoff chance; that estimate remains 0% after either a win or a loss. Alex has overwhelming model support, while Cooper’s supplied playoff outlook does not change based on this result.
